comments.author: @RealLifeFilesDoc
comments.text: Sain Uu! Watching this at 9:27 PM on a Saturday from Phu Tho, Vietnam 🇻🇳. As a documentary video editor, I am completely blown away by the wildlife cinematography here. The B-roll in image_3c741d.jpg, capturing the elusive Snow Leopard—the "Ghost of the Mountain"—so clearly in the snow [21:19] is a masterpiece. And learning that local nomads are protecting them through the Snow Leopard Trust by selling wool crafts instead of hunting them [22:31] is the kind of conservation story the world needs to hear. For the next video, I'm guessing Peru! 🇲🇳🎥
